meta.name: ਪੰਜਾਬੀ
meta.aiNote: ਇਸ ਪ੍ਰੋਟੋਟਾਈਪ ਦਾ ਸਾਰਾ ਲਿਖਤ AI ਨਾਲ ਬਣਿਆ ਹੈ। CVH ਸ਼ੁਰੂ ਹੋਣ ਤੋਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਲੋਕ ਇਸਦੀ ਜਾਂਚ ਕਰਨਗੇ।

terms.draftBody: ਇਸ ਲਿਖਤ ਨੂੰ ਅਜੇ ਮਨਜ਼ੂਰੀ ਨਹੀਂ ਮਿਲੀ। ਇਹ ਆਖ਼ਰੀ ਸ਼ਰਤਾਂ ਨਹੀਂ ਹਨ। ਇਸ ਦੇ ਭਰੋਸੇ ਸਾਈਨ ਅੱਪ ਨਾ ਕਰੋ।
terms.translationNote: ਇਸ ਪੰਨੇ ਦੇ ਕੁਝ ਹਿੱਸਿਆਂ ਦਾ ਅਜੇ {lang} ਵਿੱਚ ਅਨੁਵਾਦ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੋਇਆ। ਉਹ ਹਿੱਸੇ ਅੰਗਰੇਜ਼ੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਦਿਸਦੇ ਹਨ।
terms.dataDeletedNote: CVH ਪਾਇਲਟ ਖਤਮ ਹੋ ਗਿਆ ਹੈ। ਉਸ ਤਾਰੀਖ ਨੂੰ ਅਸੀਂ ਉਹਨਾਂ ਸਭ ਲੋਕਾਂ ਦਾ ਫ਼ੋਨ ਨੰਬਰ ਅਤੇ ਚੋਣਾਂ ਹਟਾ ਦਿੱਤੀਆਂ ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੇ ਅਲਰਟ ਮਿਲਦੇ ਰਹਿਣ ਲਈ YES ਜਵਾਬ ਨਹੀਂ ਦਿੱਤਾ।

x03.title: ਇਸ ਥਾਂ ਦੇ ਨਿਯਮ
x03.intro: CVH ਗੁਆਂਢੀਆਂ ਦੀ ਇੱਕ-ਦੂਜੇ ਦੀ ਮਦਦ ਲਈ ਹੈ। ਕੁਝ ਜੋੜਨ ਤੋਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਇਹ ਪੜ੍ਹੋ।
rules: ਮੁਫ਼ਤ ਜਾਂ ਘੱਟ ਕੀਮਤ ਵਾਲੀਆਂ ਅਤੇ ਸਭ ਲਈ ਖੁੱਲ੍ਹੀਆਂ ਥਾਵਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਮਦਦ ਸਾਂਝੀ ਕਰੋ।
ਕਿਸੇ ਥਾਂ ਬਾਰੇ ਲਿਖੋ, ਕਿਸੇ ਵਿਅਕਤੀ ਬਾਰੇ ਨਹੀਂ। ਕਿਸੇ ਦਾ ਨਾਮ, ਯੂਨਿਟ ਨੰਬਰ ਜਾਂ ਫ਼ੋਨ ਨੰਬਰ ਨਾ ਦਿਓ।
ਦਿਆਲੂ ਰਹੋ। ਕਿਸੇ ਸਮੂਹ ਦਾ ਅਪਮਾਨ ਜਾਂ ਨਿਸ਼ਾਨਾ ਨਹੀਂ।
ਸਿਰਫ਼ ਉਹੀ ਸਾਂਝਾ ਕਰੋ ਜੋ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਜਾਣਦੇ ਹੋ ਕਿ ਸੱਚ ਹੈ। ਯਕੀਨ ਨਾ ਹੋਵੇ ਤਾਂ "ਯਕੀਨ ਨਹੀਂ" ਚੁਣੋ।
x03.market: CVH ਬਾਜ਼ਾਰ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੈ। ਨਾ ਵਿਕਰੀ, ਨਾ ਇਸ਼ਤਿਹਾਰ।

R21.title: ਹੱਬ ਨੂੰ ਭੇਜਿਆ ਗਿਆ
R21.general: ਹੱਬ ਦਾ ਕੋਈ ਵਿਅਕਤੀ ਲਗਭਗ ਇੱਕ ਹਫ਼ਤੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਇਸ ਨੂੰ ਪੜ੍ਹੇਗਾ। ਜਦੋਂ ਇਹ ਨਕਸ਼ੇ ਤੇ ਆਵੇਗਾ, ਅਸੀਂ ਤੁਹਾਨੂੰ ਦੱਸਾਂਗੇ।
R21.ambassador: ਤੁਸੀਂ ਐਂਬੈਸਡਰ ਹੋ, ਇਸ ਲਈ ਇਸ ਦੀ ਜਾਂਚ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਹੁੰਦੀ ਹੈ। ਆਮ ਤੌਰ ਤੇ ਇਹ ਇੱਕ ਦਿਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਨਕਸ਼ੇ ਤੇ ਆ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ।
R21.n1: ਹੱਬ ਦਾ ਕੋਈ ਵਿਅਕਤੀ ਇਸ ਨੂੰ ਪੜ੍ਹਦਾ ਹੈ।
R21.n2: ਜੇ ਇਹ ਨਿਯਮਾਂ ਅਨੁਸਾਰ ਹੈ, ਤਾਂ ਇਹ ਨਕਸ਼ੇ ਤੇ ਅਤੇ ਖੋਜ ਵਿੱਚ ਆ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ।
R21.n3: ਜੇ ਕੁਝ ਬਦਲਣ ਦੀ ਲੋੜ ਹੈ, ਤਾਂ ਅਸੀਂ ਦੱਸਦੇ ਹਾਂ ਕਿ ਕੀ, ਅਤੇ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਇਸ ਨੂੰ ਦੁਬਾਰਾ ਭੇਜ ਸਕਦੇ ਹੋ।
R21.n1Amb: ਹੱਬ ਦਾ ਕੋਈ ਵਿਅਕਤੀ ਇਸ ਨੂੰ ਆਮ ਕਤਾਰ ਤੋਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਪੜ੍ਹਦਾ ਹੈ।
R21.dayLine: ਆਮ ਤੌਰ ਤੇ ਇੱਕ ਦਿਨ ਵਿੱਚ
R21.protoDecline: ਉਹ ਥਾਂ ਦੇਖੋ ਜੋ ਹੱਬ ਨੇ ਵਾਪਸ ਭੇਜੀ

R22.title: ਇਹ ਥਾਂ ਠੀਕ ਕਰੋ
R22.changeOne: ਜੋ ਗਲਤ ਹੈ ਉਹ ਬਦਲੋ। ਬਾਕੀ ਸਭ ਕੁਝ ਉਵੇਂ ਹੀ ਰਹੇਗਾ।
R22.sent: ਧੰਨਵਾਦ। ਹੱਬ ਇਸ ਤਬਦੀਲੀ ਦੀ ਜਾਂਚ ਕਰੇਗਾ।
R22.nothingYet: ਘੱਟੋ-ਘੱਟ ਇੱਕ ਚੀਜ਼ ਬਦਲੋ, ਫਿਰ ਭੇਜੋ।
R22.onlyThis: ਸਿਰਫ਼ ਉਹੀ ਭੇਜਿਆ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ ਜੋ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਬਦਲਦੇ ਹੋ। ਥਾਂ ਅੱਪਡੇਟ ਹੋਣ ਤੋਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਹੱਬ ਇਸ ਦੀ ਜਾਂਚ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ।

R23.kept: ਤੁਸੀਂ ਜੋ ਵੀ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਉਹ ਸੰਭਾਲਿਆ ਹੋਇਆ ਹੈ।

advert.why: ਇਹ ਕੁਝ ਵੇਚਦਾ ਹੈ ਜਾਂ ਪੈਸੇ ਮੰਗਦਾ ਹੈ। CVH ਬਾਜ਼ਾਰ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੈ।
advert.change: ਜੇ ਇਸ ਦਾ ਕੋਈ ਮੁਫ਼ਤ ਹਿੱਸਾ ਹੈ ਜੋ ਕੋਈ ਵੀ ਵਰਤ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ, ਤਾਂ ਸਿਰਫ਼ ਉਸ ਹਿੱਸੇ ਬਾਰੇ ਦੱਸੋ। ਕੀਮਤਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਭੁਗਤਾਨ ਬਾਰੇ ਨਾ ਲਿਖੋ।

R24.title: ਤਿਆਰ ਰਹੋ
R24.lead: ਇੱਥੇ ਹੋਣ ਵਾਲੀਆਂ ਛੇ ਰੁਕਾਵਟਾਂ ਤੋਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ, ਦੌਰਾਨ ਅਤੇ ਬਾਅਦ ਵਿੱਚ ਕੀ ਕਰਨਾ ਹੈ।
R24.numbers: ਨੰਬਰ ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੀ ਮੈਨੂੰ ਲੋੜ ਪੈ ਸਕਦੀ ਹੈ
R24.headsUp: ਹਰ ਮੌਸਮ ਤੋਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਅਗਾਊਂ ਸੂਚਨਾ

R24.checkinLine: ਤੁਹਾਡੀ ਮੰਜ਼ਿਲ ਦਾ ਐਂਬੈਸਡਰ ਤੁਹਾਡਾ ਹਾਲ ਪੁੱਛਦਾ ਹੈ। ਇਹ ਐਮਰਜੈਂਸੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੈ।
R24.headsUpLine: ਸਿਰਫ਼ CVH ਵਿੱਚ, ਕਦੇ ਵੀ ਟੈਕਸਟ ਮੈਸੇਜ ਰਾਹੀਂ ਨਹੀਂ

R26.title: ਤੁਸੀਂ ਕਿਹੜੇ ਸਮੂਹਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਆਉਂਦੇ ਹੋ?
R26.lead: ਜੋ ਵੀ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਤੇ ਢੁੱਕਦੇ ਹਨ, ਉਹ ਚੁਣੋ। ਇਸ ਨਾਲ ਤੈਅ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ ਕਿ ਤੁਹਾਨੂੰ ਕਿਹੜੀਆਂ ਚੇਤਾਵਨੀਆਂ ਮਿਲਦੀਆਂ ਹਨ ਅਤੇ ਕਿਹੜੀ ਸਲਾਹ ਦਿਸਦੀ ਹੈ। ਅਸੀਂ ਕਦੇ ਨਹੀਂ ਪੁੱਛਦੇ ਕਿਉਂ।
R26.skipLine: ਛੱਡਣ ਨਾਲ ਤੁਹਾਨੂੰ ਮਿਲਣ ਵਾਲੀਆਂ ਚੇਤਾਵਨੀਆਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਕੁਝ ਨਹੀਂ ਬਦਲਦਾ।
R26.helperConfirm: ਮੈਂ ਕਿਸੇ ਦੀ ਮਦਦ ਕਰ ਰਿਹਾ ਹਾਂ। ਉਹ ਇਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਚੋਣਾਂ ਨਾਲ ਸਹਿਮਤ ਹਨ।
R26.helperNote: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਕੇ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਪੁੱਛੋ।
R26.checkinNext: ਅੱਗੇ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਆਪਣੀ ਬਿਲਡਿੰਗ ਅਤੇ ਮੰਜ਼ਿਲ ਚੁਣੋਗੇ, ਫਿਰ ਇਹ ਕਿ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਆਪਣਾ ਹਾਲ ਕਿਵੇਂ ਪੁੱਛਵਾਉਣਾ ਚਾਹੁੰਦੇ ਹੋ।
R26.helperNeeded: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਕੇ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਪੁੱਛੋ। ਜਦੋਂ ਉਹ ਸਹਿਮਤ ਹੋ ਜਾਣ ਤਾਂ ਡੱਬੇ ਤੇ ਨਿਸ਼ਾਨ ਲਗਾਓ, ਜਾਂ ਇਹ ਸਵਾਲ ਛੱਡ ਦਿਓ।

R27.title: ਫਿਲਟਰ
R27.lead: ਸਿਰਫ਼ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਸਵਾਲਾਂ ਦੇ ਜਵਾਬ ਦਿਓ ਜੋ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਲਈ ਜ਼ਰੂਰੀ ਹਨ। ਬਾਕੀ ਸਭ ਖੁੱਲ੍ਹਾ ਰਹਿੰਦਾ ਹੈ।
R27.langHint: ਉਹ ਥਾਵਾਂ ਦਿਖਾਉਂਦਾ ਹੈ ਜਿੱਥੇ ਕੋਈ ਇਹ ਭਾਸ਼ਾ ਬੋਲਦਾ ਹੈ। ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਥਾਵਾਂ ਨੇ ਸਾਨੂੰ ਨਹੀਂ ਦੱਸਿਆ, ਉਹ ਛੱਡ ਦਿੱਤੀਆਂ ਜਾਂਦੀਆਂ ਹਨ।
R27.noIdHint: ਸਿਰਫ਼ ਉਹ ਥਾਵਾਂ ਦਿਖਾਉਂਦਾ ਹੈ ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੇ ਹੱਬ ਨੂੰ ਦੱਸਿਆ ਹੈ ਕਿ ਉਹ ਤੁਹਾਡੀ ਮਦਦ ਕਰਨ ਲਈ ਪਛਾਣ ਪੱਤਰ, ਕਾਗਜ਼ ਜਾਂ ਇਮੀਗ੍ਰੇਸ਼ਨ ਸਟੇਟਸ ਨਹੀਂ ਪੁੱਛਣਗੀਆਂ। ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਥਾਵਾਂ ਨੇ ਸਾਨੂੰ ਨਹੀਂ ਦੱਸਿਆ, ਉਹ ਛੱਡ ਦਿੱਤੀਆਂ ਜਾਂਦੀਆਂ ਹਨ, ਤਾਂ ਜੋ ਅੰਦਰ ਜਾਣ ਤੇ ਤੁਹਾਨੂੰ ਪੁੱਛਿਆ ਨਾ ਜਾਵੇ।
R27.private: ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਜਵਾਬ ਇਸ ਫ਼ੋਨ ਤੇ ਹੀ ਰਹਿੰਦੇ ਹਨ। ਉਹ ਨਾ ਸੰਭਾਲੇ ਜਾਂਦੇ ਹਨ, ਨਾ ਕਿਸੇ ਨੂੰ ਭੇਜੇ ਜਾਂਦੇ ਹਨ।
R27.applyNone: ਲਾਗੂ ਕਰੋ (ਅਜੇ ਕੁਝ ਮੇਲ ਨਹੀਂ ਖਾਂਦਾ)

R28.title: "ਪੁਸ਼ਟੀ ਹੋਈ" ਦਾ ਮਤਲਬ
R28.body: ਪੁਸ਼ਟੀ ਹੋਈ ਦਾ ਮਤਲਬ ਹੈ ਕਿ ਹੱਬ ਦੇ ਕਿਸੇ ਵਿਅਕਤੀ ਨੇ, ਜਾਂ ਹੱਬ ਨਾਲ ਕੰਮ ਕਰਨ ਵਾਲੀ ਕਿਸੇ ਸਾਥੀ ਸੰਸਥਾ ਦੇ ਵਿਅਕਤੀ ਨੇ, ਇਹ ਚੇਤਾਵਨੀ ਭੇਜਣ ਤੋਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਮੌਕੇ ਤੇ ਮੌਜੂਦ ਲੋਕਾਂ ਨਾਲ ਇਸ ਦੀ ਜਾਂਚ ਕੀਤੀ।
R28.who: {org} ਨੇ {t} ਇਸ ਚੇਤਾਵਨੀ ਦੀ ਪੁਸ਼ਟੀ ਕੀਤੀ।
R28.notYet: ਅਜੇ ਪੁਸ਼ਟੀ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੋਈ ਦਾ ਮਤਲਬ ਹੈ ਕਿ ਚੇਤਾਵਨੀ ਕਿਸੇ ਬਿਲਡਿੰਗ ਐਂਬੈਸਡਰ ਤੋਂ ਆਈ ਹੈ, ਜਿਸ ਨੂੰ ਅਕਸਰ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਪਤਾ ਲੱਗਦਾ ਹੈ। ਹੱਬ ਜਿੰਨੀ ਜਲਦੀ ਹੋ ਸਕੇ ਇਸ ਦੀ ਜਾਂਚ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ।
R28.official: ਅਧਿਕਾਰਤ ਚੇਤਾਵਨੀਆਂ {source} ਤੋਂ ਆਉਂਦੀਆਂ ਹਨ ਅਤੇ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੇ ਸ਼ਬਦ ਬਦਲੇ ਬਿਨਾਂ ਅੱਗੇ ਭੇਜੀਆਂ ਜਾਂਦੀਆਂ ਹਨ।
R28.notFalse: ਅਜੇ ਪੁਸ਼ਟੀ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੋਈ ਦਾ ਮਤਲਬ ਇਹ ਨਹੀਂ ਕਿ ਇਹ ਗਲਤ ਹੈ।

R29.title: ਇਹ ਚੇਤਾਵਨੀ ਸਾਂਝੀ ਕਰੋ
R29.everyone: ਹਰ ਕਿਸੇ ਨੂੰ ਇਹੀ ਸੰਸਕਰਣ ਮਿਲਦਾ ਹੈ। ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਲਈ ਬਣਾਈ ਕੋਈ ਗੱਲ ਸਾਂਝੀ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੁੰਦੀ।
R29.notRecorded: CVH ਇਹ ਦਰਜ ਨਹੀਂ ਕਰਦਾ ਕਿ ਚੇਤਾਵਨੀਆਂ ਕੌਣ ਸਾਂਝੀਆਂ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ ਜਾਂ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਕਿਸ ਨੂੰ ਭੇਜਦੇ ਹੋ।
R29.handed: ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਫ਼ੋਨ ਦੇ ਸਾਂਝਾ ਕਰਨ ਵਾਲੇ ਵਿਕਲਪ ਇੱਥੇ ਖੁੱਲ੍ਹਣਗੇ।
R29.lead: ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਗੁਆਂਢੀਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਚੇਤਾਵਨੀ ਉਵੇਂ ਹੀ ਮਿਲਦੀ ਹੈ ਜਿਵੇਂ ਹੱਬ ਨੇ ਲਿਖੀ, ਨਾਲ ਇਹ ਕਿ ਇਹ ਕਿੱਥੋਂ ਆਈ ਅਤੇ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਨਵੇਂ ਸੰਸਕਰਣ ਦਾ ਲਿੰਕ।
R29.linkLine: ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਨਵੇਂ ਅੱਪਡੇਟ ਅਤੇ ਕੋਈ ਵੀ ਸੋਧ: {url}
R29.sendLine: ਤੁਹਾਡਾ ਫ਼ੋਨ ਪੁੱਛੇਗਾ ਕਿ ਇਹ ਕਿਸ ਐਪ ਨਾਲ ਭੇਜਣਾ ਹੈ।
R29.copied: ਕਾਪੀ ਹੋ ਗਿਆ। ਤੁਸੀਂ ਇਸਨੂੰ ਕਿਸੇ ਵੀ ਐਪ ਵਿੱਚ ਪੇਸਟ ਕਰ ਸਕਦੇ ਹੋ।
R29.copyFailed: ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਫ਼ੋਨ ਨੇ ਇਸਨੂੰ ਕਾਪੀ ਨਹੀਂ ਕੀਤਾ। ਕਾਪੀ ਕਰਨ ਲਈ ਉੱਪਰਲੇ ਸੁਨੇਹੇ ਨੂੰ ਦਬਾ ਕੇ ਰੱਖੋ।
R29.noSheet: ਤੁਹਾਡਾ ਫ਼ੋਨ ਇੱਥੇ ਸਾਂਝਾ ਕਰਨ ਦੇ ਵਿਕਲਪ ਨਹੀਂ ਦਿੰਦਾ। ਸੁਨੇਹਾ ਕਾਪੀ ਕਰੋ, ਜਾਂ ਇਸਨੂੰ WhatsApp ਤੇ ਭੇਜੋ।

R30.noChange: ਬਾਅਦ ਵਿੱਚ ਖੋਲ੍ਹਿਆ: ਇਹ ਭੇਜਣ ਤੋਂ ਬਾਅਦ ਕੁਝ ਨਵਾਂ ਪੋਸਟ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੋਇਆ।

A05.chosen: ਵਸਨੀਕ ਨੂੰ ਦੱਸੋ ਕਿ {service} ਤੱਕ ਕਿਵੇਂ ਪਹੁੰਚਣਾ ਹੈ, ਜਾਂ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਲਈ ਲਿਖ ਦਿਓ।
A05.neverText: ਅਸੀਂ ਇਹ ਟੈਕਸਟ ਮੈਸੇਜ ਰਾਹੀਂ ਨਹੀਂ ਭੇਜਦੇ।
A05.recorded: ਇਸ ਤਰ੍ਹਾਂ ਦਰਜ ਕੀਤਾ: {category}। ਹੋਰ ਕੁਝ ਨਹੀਂ ਸੰਭਾਲਿਆ ਜਾਂਦਾ।
A05.exNote: ਅਭਿਆਸ: ਇਹ ਅਭਿਆਸ ਹੈ। ਤੁਸੀਂ ਜੋ ਚੁਣਦੇ ਹੋ ਉਹ ਸਿਰਫ਼ ਅਭਿਆਸ ਦੇ ਰਿਕਾਰਡ ਵਿੱਚ ਰੱਖਿਆ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ।
A05.openNowIn: ਹੁਣ {lang} ਵਿੱਚ ਖੁੱਲ੍ਹੀਆਂ, ਜਾਂ ਸਮਾਂ ਪਤਾ ਨਹੀਂ
A05.hoursUnknown: ਸਮਾਂ ਪਤਾ ਨਹੀਂ। ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਕਾਲ ਕਰੋ।
A05.none: ਇਸ ਲਈ ਹੁਣ {lang} ਵਿੱਚ ਕੁਝ ਖੁੱਲ੍ਹਾ ਨਹੀਂ। ਇਹ ਹੁਣ ਹੋਰ ਭਾਸ਼ਾਵਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਖੁੱਲ੍ਹੀਆਂ ਹਨ:
A05.noneAtAll: ਇੱਥੇ ਹੁਣ ਕੁਝ ਵੀ ਖੁੱਲ੍ਹਾ ਨਹੀਂ। ਹੱਬ ਮਦਦ ਕਰ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ: {phone}।
A05.sayOr: ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਬੋਲ ਕੇ ਦੱਸੋ, ਜਾਂ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਲਈ ਲਿਖ ਦਿਓ। ਤੁਸੀਂ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਇਹ ਸਕ੍ਰੀਨ ਵੀ ਦਿਖਾ ਸਕਦੇ ਹੋ।
A05.already: ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਹੀ ਕਿਸੇ ਸੇਵਾ ਨਾਲ ਜੋੜਿਆ: {category}।
A05.queued: ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਫ਼ੋਨ ਤੇ ਸੰਭਾਲਿਆ। ਸਿਗਨਲ ਆਉਣ ਤੇ ਇਹ ਹੱਬ ਨੂੰ ਜਾਵੇਗਾ।

O01.title: [EN] Right now
O01.lead: [EN] Open incidents, most recent first. Anything waiting for you is at the top.
O01.startWith: [EN] Or start with what is happening
O01.officialNoTrigger: [EN] No activation trigger matches this alert
O01.officialPending: [EN] Relayed to residents. The designated teams are not activated yet.
O01.officialPendingRelay: [EN] Teams activated. Not relayed to residents yet.
O01.postWaitingLine: [EN] This type waits for the Hub before it goes out. Posted {t}.
O01.postLiveLine: [EN] Went out directly on every channel {t}. Residents see "Not yet verified".
O01.postQueuedLine: [EN] No signal on the ambassador's phone. It goes out when the signal returns.
O01.postLine: [EN] Their line, translated by machine from {lang}:
O01.openNow: [EN] Open for less than a minute
O01.staleLine: [EN] {hazard} alerts are updated at least every {period} (playbook).
O01.noneLine: [EN] When something is reported, log it here. The acknowledgement goes out in every language from one screen.
O01.closedLine: [EN] Resolved {t}. Residents find it in archived alerts.
O01.openSpaceEx: [EN] Open the shared space for this exercise
O01.spaceNone: [EN] A shared space opens from a disruption. Choose "Open a shared space" on one of the open incidents above.
O01.exerciseNow: [EN] Exercise running. Disruptions you log now are practice: they are listed under "Exercise, practice only" and never reach residents. Real incidents stay real.
O01.exercisePostState: [EN] Kept in the exercise only. Nothing was sent to residents.
O01.checkinsLine: [EN] {help} need help and {nr} not reached are waiting.
O01.checkinsConn: [EN] {conn} connected to a service, to follow up.
O01.spaceLine: [EN] Open one shared space for a disruption so partners can coordinate. It starts from the playbook.
O01.readinessLine: [EN] Standing commitments, playbooks, teams and triggers.

O02.exNote: [EN] Exercise: this alert is practice. Nothing will be sent to residents.
O02.typeHint: [EN] Choosing a type fills in the checked wording for it. You can change it.
O02.templateLine: [EN] Checked by people in all 15 launch languages, with audio ({t}). Tailored advice for each group comes with it. You do not write it.
O02.noTemplateLine: [EN] Residents reading in other languages see a machine translation, labelled as one.
O02.edited: [EN] You changed the wording. The changed parts reach other languages as a labelled machine translation until the Hub checks them.
O02.headline: [EN] Headline
O02.headlineHint: [EN] What is happening, in a few words.
O02.nykHint: [EN] For example: when it will be fixed.
O02.whereLater: [EN] Filled in from the audience you choose next.
O02.detailHint: [EN] The first entry residents read under the alert.
O02.untilResolvedLine: [EN] It stays up until you close it with a final update.
O02.untilTimeLine: [EN] It moves to the archive at that time if nobody closes it first.
O02.officialTitle: [EN] Official alert on the same event
O02.officialHint: [EN] Linking it shows residents the official alert beside this one, so the two never disagree in silence.
O02.prefilled: [EN] Filled in because it was relayed through O-18.
O02.addsHint: [EN] One line, for example: This message adds the cooling spaces open near you.
O02.byGroupLine: [EN] Groups residents chose to join, and language.
O02.bothLine: [EN] For example, seniors in one building.
O02.previewLine: [EN] Shown in English. Residents read it in their own language.
O02.neverShown: [EN] Residents never see who it was aimed at or why they got it.

power.headline: [EN] Power is out
power.action: [EN] Keep your fridge and freezer closed. Use a flashlight, not candles.
power.detail: [EN] Power is out. We are finding out why.

water.headline: [EN] Water is off for a pipe repair
water.notYetKnown: [EN] When the water will be back on
water.action: [EN] Fill a jug of water now if you still can.
water.detail: [EN] The building has shut off the water to repair a pipe.

elevator.headline: [EN] Elevator is out
elevator.action: [EN] Use the stairs with care. Call the Hub if you cannot manage the stairs.
elevator.detail: [EN] The elevator is out of service.

flood.headline: [EN] Water is leaking in the building
flood.notYetKnown: [EN] Where the leak is coming from
flood.action: [EN] Stay away from the water and move things off the floor.
flood.detail: [EN] Water is leaking in the building. The superintendent has been told.

fire.headline: [EN] Fire alarm in the building
fire.action: [EN] Leave by the stairs. Do not use the elevator.

smoke.headline: [EN] Smoky air today
smoke.notYetKnown: [EN] How long the smoke will last
smoke.action: [EN] Keep windows closed and spend time somewhere with clean air.
smoke.detail: [EN] Smoke from wildfires is making the air unhealthy today.

winter.headline: [EN] Winter storm tonight
winter.action: [EN] Stay in if you can and charge your phone now.
winter.detail: [EN] A winter storm is expected tonight.

O03.exNote: [EN] Exercise: the reach is shown for practice. Nothing will be sent to residents.
O03.lead: [EN] Choose whole neighbourhoods, buildings, or floors in a building. You can mix them.
O03.searchHint: [EN] Type part of the address, for example 25 Thor or Tower B.
O03.noMatch: [EN] No building matches "{q}". Check the address, or choose a whole neighbourhood.
O03.pickHint: [EN] Tap each floor. Tap again to remove it.
O03.addGroup: [EN] Narrow to a group as well
O03.groupsKept: [EN] Groups chosen: {groups}. They are applied on top of this place.

O04.exNote: [EN] Exercise: the reach is shown for practice. Nothing will be sent to residents.
O04.lead: [EN] Aim at the groups residents chose to join, and at language. There is nothing else to aim at.
O04.groupsHint: [EN] The same four groups residents see when they choose. Someone in two of them gets one message.
O04.everyLangLine: [EN] Everyone in the group, whatever language they read.
O04.someLangs: [EN] Or only residents who read in:
O04.limitsTitle: [EN] What the CVH cannot target on
O04.limits: [EN] Groups are built only from what residents chose to tell the CVH: their language and these four groups. There is no age, health, immigration status, income or religion to aim at, and nothing is guessed from what people do.
O04.neverShown: [EN] Residents never see which group or place they were chosen by.
O04.inWhole: [EN] Anywhere in Thorncliffe Park and Flemingdon Park.
O04.inPlace: [EN] Counted inside {place} only, not added to it.
O04.twoGroups: [EN] Someone in two groups is counted in each, and gets one message.
O04.small: [EN] A message to a group this small could let people work out who received it and why. Widen the place or the group if you can. You can still send it.
O04.zeroTitle: [EN] Nobody here has chosen this yet
O04.zero: [EN] No resident in this place has chosen this. Widen the place or choose another group.
O04.pending: [EN] Choose a group or a language to see how many residents it reaches.

O05.generated: [EN] Written by the CVH from what you chose. Check it says what you mean.
O05.intersection: [EN] Only residents in both are counted: {n} who chose {group}, inside {place}. Not the {households} households there plus {n}.
O05.unTitle: [EN] Not reachable by text or app
O05.unLine: [EN] Not counted in the reach. After you send, they are passed to the floor ambassadors who cover them.
O05.unGroup: [EN] The CVH cannot know which of them are in the group, so the ambassadors are asked to check on all of them.
O05.unGroupOnly: [EN] Not counted in the reach. The CVH cannot know which of them are in the group, so nobody is asked to follow up automatically. To hand them to the ambassadors, narrow by place as well.
O05.langsOnlyMt: [EN] In {langs} only. Parts you wrote are machine translated and labelled.
O05.noAmb: [EN] No floor ambassador covers this place yet.
O05.langSmall: [EN] Not broken down by language, because the group is small.
O05.noCover: [EN] Floors with no ambassador are listed on the confirmation. The Hub follows up by phone or at the door.
O05.channels: [EN] Text messages, the app and web, and the ambassadors' rounds. One send reaches all of them.
O05.langsLine: [EN] In all 15 launch languages, with audio.
O05.langsMt: [EN] In all 15 launch languages. Parts you wrote are machine translated and labelled.
O05.smallAck: [EN] I have read the small-group warning and still want to send this.
O05.exTitle: [EN] Exercise. Nothing will be sent to residents.
O05.exLine: [EN] The reach is shown for practice. Nothing here is acted on.
O05.ready: [EN] Ready. One send reaches every channel.

O06.ackNow: [EN] Acknowledged within a minute of logging
O06.titleExercise: [EN] Practice publish: nothing was sent to residents
O06.leadExercise: [EN] This is an exercise. The rows below show what would have gone where.
O06.vApp: [EN] On Alerts for residents who follow {where}. It shows "Verified by {org}".
O06.vText: [EN] About {n} phones, each in the language the resident chose. Illustrative.
O06.vLangs: [EN] {n} launch languages from the checked template {id}.
O06.vAudio: [EN] An audio version in every language, {t} each.
O06.vTailored: [EN] Added for residents who chose a group. Nobody is told why they got it.
O06.ambLead: [EN] Households on these floors who cannot be reached by phone or app are on each ambassador's round, with the text to carry.
O06.unreachable: [EN] {n} households on these floors are listed as not reachable digitally.
O06.gapLine: [EN] Nobody carries the alert to these floors. They are named in the shared space.
O06.noAmb: [EN] No floor ambassador covers this area.
O06.nextStale: [EN] Post an update within {period}. After that the incident shows as stale on operator home.
O06.nextPromote: [EN] When you know more, promote this to a full alert. Residents keep the same alert; nothing is re-entered.

O07.exNote: [EN] Exercise: approving, verifying or declining here is practice. Nothing will be sent to residents or back to the ambassador.
O07.stateQueued: [EN] On the ambassador's phone, waiting for signal
O07.residentsSee: [EN] Residents see only: Building ambassador, {building}. Never the name.
O07.noLine: [EN] No line of text. The type and floors come from templates.
O07.liveNow: [EN] Live on every channel for {t}, text messages included. Residents see it marked "Not yet verified".
O07.waitingNow: [EN] Not sent yet. It has waited {t}. Fire alarm and Other posts wait for the Hub before they go out.
O07.queuedNow: [EN] Not sent yet. It will send from {name}'s phone when there is signal.
O07.verifyLine: [EN] Changes the marker on this same post to "Verified by the Hub". No second message is sent.
O07.approveLine: [EN] Sends it on every channel, marked "Verified by the Hub".
O07.editHint: [EN] Other languages are translated from this.
O07.approveEdited: [EN] Approve and send with these changes
O07.declineHint: [EN] {name} sees this reason on the post. Pick one; there is nothing to write.
O07.withdrawHint: [EN] Residents see that the post was withdrawn, with this reason.
declineReasons: [EN] The Hub checked. It was a false alarm, and nothing needs to go out.
[EN] The building has already told everyone.
[EN] Wrong floors or building. Please post it again.
[EN] This needs 911 or the building, not a message to residents.
withdrawReasons: [EN] A Hub alert now covers this.
O07.doneVerified: [EN] Verified. Residents now see "Verified by the Hub" on the same post.
O07.doneApproved: [EN] Approved. It went out on every channel, marked "Verified by the Hub".
O07.addDetails: [EN] Add details to make it a full alert
O07.noneLine: [EN] New posts arrive here and at the top of Incidents as they happen.

actions.power: [EN] Keep your fridge and freezer closed. Use a flashlight, not candles.
actions.water: [EN] Ask a neighbour on a lower floor for water if you need it.
actions.flood: [EN] Stay away from the water and move things off the floor.
actions.fire: [EN] If you hear the alarm, leave by the stairs. Do not use the elevator.
actions.other: [EN] Stay safe. If someone is in danger, call 911.

O08.exNote: [EN] Exercise: decisions made during the exercise are practice. They do not change the map or search.
O08.fits: [EN] Fits in the time set aside, with about {n} minutes to spare.
O08.fitsOne: [EN] Fits in the time set aside, with about 1 minute to spare.
O08.fitsExact: [EN] Fits in the time set aside.
O08.over: [EN] Will not fit. About {n} minutes more than the time set aside.
O08.overLine: [EN] In queue order, the last {n} wait until next week.
O08.lighter: [EN] If this happens most weeks, the contribution form should get lighter, not the review faster.
O08.estimateHow: [EN] Estimate: half a minute for a correction, 1 minute for a new place, plus half a minute for a translation and more when something is missing.
O08.ambLaneLine: [EN] Checked first. Ambassadors are told it is usually on the map within a day.
O08.split: [EN] {a} on the ambassador lane, {g} on the general lane
O08.genLaneLine: [EN] Oldest first. Residents are told about a week.
O08.emptyLine: [EN] New submissions appear here, oldest first. Nothing needs you now.
O08.correctionOf: [EN] Changes the {what} of a place already on the map.
O08.selectEasy: [EN] Select those with nothing missing and nothing to pay ({n})
O08.selectEasyHint: [EN] Nothing missing: a place and a category are given. Nothing to pay: they answered Free. Read each line before you accept.
O08.batchLine: [EN] Each goes on the map and in search, and each person who sent one is told.
O08.cantSelect: [EN] Open it to review: no place given
O08.batchDone: [EN] Accepted {n} together. They are on the map and in search now.
O08.justAccepted: [EN] Accepted: “{name}”. It is on the map and in search now.
O08.justAcceptedCorr: [EN] Correction applied to “{name}”. Residents see the change now.
O08.justDeclined: [EN] Declined: “{name}”. The reason was sent in {lang}, with what to change.
O08.allClear: [EN] The queue is empty. Nothing else needs you this week.

O09.exNote: [EN] Exercise: this decision is practice. It does not change the map or search, and nothing is sent to the person who suggested it.
O09.wroteLine: [EN] The one sentence typed on the form. Everything under Their answers was chosen, not typed.
O09.writtenEn: [EN] Written in English. No translation needed.

checks.amb: [EN] Sent by a building ambassador. A lighter check: that it reads right and is in the right place.
checks.corr: [EN] Only the {what} changes. Everything else about the place stays as it is.
checks.noWhere: [EN] No place given. It cannot go on the map without one.
checks.noCat: [EN] No category chosen. It still shows on the map and in search by name, but not under a topic.
checks.notSure: [EN] {n} answers are Not sure. That is allowed. Residents see Not known.
checks.notSureOne: [EN] 1 answer is Not sure. That is allowed. Residents see Not known.
checks.translated: [EN] Written in {lang}. The original stays beside the machine translation.

rule.title: [EN] The marketplace rule, applied to this one
rule.q3: [EN] Does it name a shop, brand or discount?
rule.a1service: [EN] An organisation or service. They chose Official service.
rule.a2pay: [EN] No set price. It says “pay what you can”.
rule.a2low: [EN] No set price given. They answered Low cost.
rule.saleRead: [EN] This reads as selling. If you agree, decline it with the selling or advertising reason. It tells them to describe only a free part, if there is one.
rule.whyNot: [EN] Why this is not an advert: neighbours offer it, there is no set price, and no shop, brand or discount is named. The rule is about selling and advertising, not about asking for what people can give.
rule.whyNotOrg: [EN] Asking for what people can give is not selling, and no shop, brand or discount is named.
rule.fixLine: [EN] Only the name reads like an advert. Take the payment words out of the name. The cost stays as {cost}, so residents still know.
rule.fixBtn: [EN] Accept with this name, as a community offer
rule.fixNote: [EN] One tap. They are told the name was shortened.

acceptLine.service: [EN] It goes on the map and in search.
acceptLine.communityOffer: [EN] It goes on the map and in search as a community offer, with a dashed outline.
acceptLine.correction: [EN] The change shows on the place at once.

O09.declineLine: [EN] Choose a pre-written reason. Nothing to write.
O09.editLine: [EN] Only when a small fix saves sending it back. If you edit often, the form needs to change, not you.
O09.needsPlace: [EN] It needs a place before it can go on the map. Add one with Edit, or decline so they can add it.
O09.editing: [EN] Editing. Change only what is needed.
O09.wherePh: [EN] For example: East York Town Centre, inside by the food court
O09.onMap: [EN] Now on the map and in search
O09.told: [EN] The person who sent it is told it is on the map.
O09.toldCorr: [EN] The person who sent it is told the change is live.
O09.declinedLine: [EN] Reason sent: {reason}. They can change it and send it again, with what they wrote kept.

O10.exNote: [EN] Exercise: this decline is practice. Nothing is sent to the person who suggested it.
O10.title: [EN] Decline: “{name}”
O10.lead: [EN] Choose one reason. They get it in their language, with what to change. You do not write anything.
O10.previewLine: [EN] Resident screen R-23, on their phone, in {lang}. Shown here in English.
O10.previewLineEn: [EN] Resident screen R-23, on their phone, in English.
O10.previewEmpty: [EN] Choose a reason to see what they will read.
O10.protoNote: [EN] In this prototype the reasons are written in English only. At launch each reason is pre-written in all {n} launch languages, so choosing one sends it in theirs.
O10.sentLine: [EN] “{name}” was sent back with the reason: {reason}. They can change it and send it again, with everything they wrote kept.

O11.title: [EN] Log a disruption
O11.lead: [EN] Two things: what is happening and where. The acknowledgement is written for you on the next screen.
O11.benchmark: [EN] Aim: the acknowledgement out within 5 to 10 minutes of the first report.
O11.sampleAll: [EN] Sample Towers A, B and C
O11.searchPh: [EN] Type a street or building number
O11.noMatch: [EN] No building matches. Try the street name.
O11.floorsHint: [EN] All floors unless you narrow it. The same range applies to every building chosen.
O11.nbhdOnlyHint: [EN] Heat, smoke and winter storms are raised for a neighbourhood, not a building.
O11.notReady: [EN] Choose what is happening and where to continue.
O11.exercise: [EN] Exercise: this disruption is practice. Nothing will reach residents.

O12.benchmark: [EN] Aim: out within 5 to 10 minutes of the first report.
O12.lead: [EN] This acknowledgement is written for you from the checked template. Read it, then publish. You do not write or translate anything.
O12.templateNone: [EN] General acknowledgement (no hazard template for this type in the sample data)
O12.previewNote: [EN] English shown. Each resident gets their own language, in this same order.
O12.langsLead: [EN] All {n} versions come from the same checked template, with an audio version for each. You can read them; you cannot edit them.
O12.notInProto: [EN] The checked {lang} wording is not in this prototype. It says the same as the English:
O12.tailoredTitle: [EN] Tailored blocks that come with this template
O12.tailoredLead: [EN] Read-only. Written and checked with the template, in every language. A resident sees a block only for a group they chose, and is never told why.
O12.tailoredNone: [EN] No tailored blocks for this type.
O12.channelsLead: [EN] One publish sends to every channel. Nothing to tick.
O12.chApp: [EN] App and web: on Alerts for everyone who follows this area
O12.chAmbNone: [EN] Floor ambassadors: none cover this area
O12.validHint: [EN] It stays on Alerts until then. You can change this with any update.
O12.oneAction: [EN] One action publishes in every language, on every channel.
O12.exercise: [EN] Exercise: publishing is practice. Nothing will be sent to residents.
O12.publishedLine: [EN] This acknowledgement is live. Update it from the incident as you learn more.

power.headline: [EN] Power is out
power.text: [EN] Power is out{on}. We are finding out why. More information to come.
power.action: [EN] Keep your fridge and freezer closed. Use a flashlight, not candles.

water.headline: [EN] Water is off
water.text: [EN] Water is off{on}. We are finding out why. More information to come.
water.action: [EN] Keep some water aside when it comes back. Ask a neighbour on another floor if you need water now.

elevator.headline: [EN] The elevator is not working
elevator.text: [EN] The elevator is not working{in}. We are finding out why. More information to come.
elevator.action: [EN] Use the stairs with care. Your floor ambassador can help bring things up.

fire.headline: [EN] Fire alarm
fire.text: [EN] The fire alarm is ringing{on}. We are finding out why. More information to come.
fire.action: [EN] If you hear the alarm, leave by the stairs. Do not use the elevator.

flood.headline: [EN] Water is leaking
flood.text: [EN] Water is leaking{on}. We are finding out where it comes from. More information to come.
flood.nyk: [EN] Where the water is coming from
flood.action: [EN] Stay away from the water and move things off the floor.

heat.headline: [EN] Extreme heat
heat.text: [EN] It is dangerously hot today. We are checking which cooling spaces are open. More information to come.
heat.nyk: [EN] How long the heat will last
heat.action: [EN] Drink water often and spend a few hours each day somewhere cool.

smoke.headline: [EN] Wildfire smoke
smoke.text: [EN] There is wildfire smoke in the air. We are checking which spaces have clean air. More information to come.
smoke.nyk: [EN] How long the smoke will last
smoke.action: [EN] Keep windows closed. Stay inside if you can.

winter.headline: [EN] Winter storm
winter.text: [EN] A winter storm is here. We are finding out what it means for the buildings. More information to come.
winter.nyk: [EN] Whether the power will go out
winter.action: [EN] Charge your phone and a battery pack now.

other.headline: [EN] Something is wrong in the building
other.text: [EN] Something is wrong{in}. We are finding out what. More information to come.
other.action: [EN] Stay where you are safe and wait for the next message.

O13.exNote: [EN] Exercise: promoting is practice. Nothing will be sent to residents.
O13.lead: [EN] Add what you know now. The same alert is updated for everyone who has it. Nothing is sent as a new alert, and nothing needs to be chosen again.
O13.elapsed: [EN] since the disruption was first logged
O13.languagesLine: [EN] All 15 launch languages, each with audio. The update is added to each one.
O13.channelsLine: [EN] Text messages, the app and web, and the ambassadors' rounds.
O13.tailored: [EN] Tailored advice for each group comes with the template.

P12.postDirectLine: [EN] A floor ambassador's post of this type goes out on every channel at once. Residents see "Not yet verified" until the Hub checks it.
P12.postHub: [EN] Ambassador posts wait for the Hub
P12.postHubLine: [EN] A floor ambassador's post of this type is held until the Hub approves it. Nothing goes out before that.
P12.postNone: [EN] Ambassadors do not post this type
P12.postNoneLine: [EN] It comes from the Hub for the whole neighbourhood, not from one building.
P12.partsTitleProposed: [EN] Day one, in four parts, as proposed
P12.partsLead: [EN] Each part is set somewhere else. The link takes you there.
P12.p4: [EN] What is asked of each partner
P12.checklistLead: [EN] These become coverage items in the shared space until someone takes them on.
P12.adjustNote: [EN] A shared space can adjust its copy for that disruption. The agreed version here does not change.

P13.title: [EN] Teams and triggers
P13.lead: [EN] Who is activated for each disruption and level, how they are reached, and the event that starts it. Each team is a role, not a person.
P13.how1: [EN] A matching event does not activate anyone by itself. A Hub staff member confirms first.
P13.how2: [EN] The team hears directly, by text message and email, from the same sender as resident alerts. It does not go through a manager.
P13.how3: [EN] Triggers are reviewed after every disruption and every exercise.
P13.seeOfficial: [EN] See an official alert that matches a trigger
P13.gapLine: [EN] Nobody is activated at this level. This is a decision to make, not an error.
P13.gapQuestion: [EN] To decide: who is activated when an elevator outage runs for more than a few days?

P14.title: [EN] Exercises
P14.lead: [EN] Practise the whole flow with the people who would do it for real. An exercise starts from a practice disruption, and nothing reaches residents.
P14.levelGap: [EN] No team is designated at this level. The exercise will show the gap.
P14.you: [EN] You run this exercise, so you are in it already.
P14.enrolledOnly: [EN] Only the people you enrol see it. Everyone else carries on as normal.
P14.summaryNone: [EN] Enrol at least one person to start.
P14.startedToast: [EN] Exercise started. Everyone enrolled now sees the exercise marker.
P14.firstNote: [EN] Starting creates a practice disruption first: {what}. The shared space and everything else open from it, never from nothing.
P14.safeLine: [EN] No text message, app alert or space status change goes out while this runs. Reach is shown for practice only. Every screen and message in the exercise carries the word Exercise.
P14.staffSees: [EN] Sees the exercise marker on every screen.
P14.ambSees: [EN] Gets a practice check-in round on his phone, marked as an exercise.
P14.nextLead: [EN] The normal screens, in the usual order. Each one shows the exercise marker.
P14.sAckDone: [EN] Practice acknowledgement published. Nothing reached residents.
P14.sSpace: [EN] Open the shared space for this exercise
P14.sSpaceNot: [EN] Not open yet. It opens from the practice disruption, with the playbook loaded.
P14.sNoticeLine: [EN] What the enrolled teams receive by text message and email, marked as an exercise.
P14.sCoverageLine: [EN] Commitments and checklist items, and the gaps nobody has taken.
P14.sRoundLine: [EN] On the enrolled ambassador's phone (A-04), in the resident app.
P14.endLine: [EN] Ending takes everyone out of exercise mode and names the record it produces.
P14.endedToast: [EN] Exercise ended. The record is named below.
P14.recordLine: [EN] It becomes a past record in Look back, labelled as an exercise, so the debrief works from real timings. Exercise figures are never counted as real.
P14.recordStatic: [EN] Static in this prototype: Look back shows a sample exercise record as the evidence.
P14.toLookBack: [EN] Open the record in Look back
P14.schedLead: [EN] Set the next one now so it happens. Repeating exercises keep the flow familiar.
P14.schedSaved: [EN] Scheduled. It repeats until someone changes it.
P14.schedNote: [EN] Illustrative: nothing is booked or sent from this prototype.

P15.title: [EN] Indicators
P15.lead: [EN] Is the CVH reaching people and being kept current? Counts and rates only.
P15.exportToast: [EN] Illustrative: a CSV of these aggregate figures and their definitions would download now. It holds no resident-level data.
P15.exportedLine: [EN] Exported {t} as a CSV of aggregate figures and definitions (illustrative). No resident-level data was included.
P15.agreed: [EN] Definitions agreed on {date} with partners and the Community Experts Board.
P15.privacy: [EN] No resident can be identified from these figures. Numbers under 5 are shown as "Fewer than 5".
rules: [EN] Counts and rates only. Names, phone numbers, addresses, units and floors are never counted here.
[EN] Any figure from 1 to 4 is shown as "Fewer than 5", in every split and every export.
[EN] Real disruptions, exercises and everyday use are counted separately and never added together.
[EN] Trust and usefulness are asked in a survey, not worked out from what people click.
[EN] The definitions are reviewed with the indicators at each quarterly review. The next one is on {review}.
P15.colRealLine: [EN] Alerts and rounds in a real disruption.
P15.colExerciseLine: [EN] Practice only. Never added to real figures.
P15.runRunning: [EN] The drill running now ({name}) is added here when it ends, never to real disruptions.
P15.exerciseNow: [EN] An exercise is running. Its figures go into the Exercise column only when it ends. Nothing on this screen changes what residents see.
P15.supLine: [EN] Shown as fewer than 5 so no household can be identified.
P15.demoRunName: [EN] Power outage exercise, Sample Towers A, B and C

reach.name: [EN] Reach by channel and language
reach.def: [EN] Share of households signed up for alerts that got at least one alert in a disruption. A household can be reached on more than one channel.

unreachable.name: [EN] Households not reachable digitally, and followed up
unreachable.def: [EN] Households on a check-in list with no phone or app, and how many an ambassador or partner then reached.

timeToAck.name: [EN] Time to first acknowledgement
timeToAck.def: [EN] Minutes from a disruption being logged to the first acknowledgement going out in every language.

stale.name: [EN] Alerts that went stale
stale.def: [EN] Alerts with no update within the period their playbook sets.

directory.name: [EN] Directory freshness and reports resolved
directory.def: [EN] Share of listings confirmed in the last 6 months, and reports of wrong details that were resolved.

rounds.name: [EN] Check-in rounds completed
rounds.def: [EN] Rounds where every household on the list was marked, out of rounds started.

everydayUse.name: [EN] Everyday use between disruptions
everydayUse.def: [EN] Visits to Find help, Map and Be ready outside any disruption. Counted as visits, not people.

smallNumber.name: [EN] Households still needing help when a disruption closed
smallNumber.def: [EN] Check-in households marked "Needs help" that were still open when the shared space closed.

trust.name: [EN] Trust and usefulness
trust.def: [EN] Asked of residents, ambassadors and partners in a short survey every quarter.

channels: [EN] Not counted: no way to know who read it
P15.trustWho: [EN] Asked in the resident app, by text message and at the Hub desk. Not inferred from behaviour.

P16.title: [EN] Look back and actions
P16.lead: [EN] Past disruptions and exercises, what happened more than once, and who is changing what because of it.
P16.reviewLine: [EN] Every quarter, with partner leads and the Community Experts Board. Not only after a major disruption.
P16.exerciseNow: [EN] An exercise is running. When it ends, its record appears here as a new exercise record. Actions you add now are kept as practice.
P16.gapsLead: [EN] Gaps that came up in more than one record. Each one needs an action with an owner.
P16.recordsLead: [EN] Records from closed shared spaces and from exercises, together.
P16.noneLine: [EN] Try another type, building or period.
P16.alsoRecurring: [EN] Also recorded here: {gap} (happened more than once)
P16.sessionRan: [EN] Ran for {t}. {n} practice actions recorded. Nothing reached residents.
P16.sessionOne: [EN] Ran for {t}. 1 practice action recorded. Nothing reached residents.
P16.sessionDebrief: [EN] Lessons are added at the debrief. The debrief record (story 3.8.3) is not in this prototype.
P16.sessionWhere: [EN] Sample Towers A, B and C
P16.running: [EN] Running now. Its record appears when it ends.
P16.demoRunName: [EN] Power outage exercise, Sample Towers A, B and C
P16.formNeed: [EN] Choose an owner role. A lesson without an owner is not an action.

suggest.Floors with no ambassador for check-ins: [EN] Recruit floor ambassadors for floors 11 and up in Sample Towers A and B, and agree a TNO phone round for any floor still without one.

P16.addedLine: [EN] It is in the actions list below and on the agenda for the review on {review}.
P16.addedToast: [EN] Action added with an owner and a due date.
P16.toPlaybook: [EN] Open the {hazard} playbook it will change
P16.addedPractice: [EN] Added during an exercise, as practice.
P16.actionsLead: [EN] {open} open, {done} done. Done actions link to what they changed.

measures.title: [EN] Pilot measures
measures.lead: [EN] Counts only. Nobody can be identified from these figures.

subscribers.heading: [EN] Subscribers
subscribers.lead: [EN] Counted by the daily job for {day}. The numbers who were receiving texts or waiting to reply YES are as they stood shortly after midnight when the day ended; confirmations and deletions are those of the day. By language and neighbourhood.
subscribers.neverRun: [EN] The daily count has not run yet. The first figures appear the morning after it first runs.

measures.receiving_retained: [EN] Receiving texts, kept after the pilot

reach.lead: [EN] Measured against the people who got the original alert. Attempted: the text was handed to the provider. Confirmed: the provider reported it delivered.

reach.drillsEmpty: [EN] No drill correction, withdrawal or final has been texted.
reach.percent: [EN] Attempted {attempted}% and confirmed {confirmed}% of those who got the original
reach.noPercent: [EN] No percentage: a figure is under 5

cost.drillsEmpty: [EN] No drill has texts with a recorded cost.
cost.noAmount: [EN] No amount: it would give away a small number of texts

cohere.entryNoShare: [EN] Translation, {month}: {calls} calls, no billed tokens yet.

cohere.drillLine: [EN] {month}: drills used {share} of the billed tokens ({drillCalls} of {allCalls} calls).

Nobody can change a measure here or in the file.

measuresExport.heading: [EN] CVH pilot measures

editions.coordinator: [EN] Coordinator edition: spend and cost per alert are left out.

Where the totals and the other figures would give one of those away, more figures read "not shown": each of them is 5 or more. A total of fewer than 5 is not broken down. Zero is shown as 0. Drills are at the end, apart, and never added to real alerts.

values.noSurvey: [EN] No survey result has been recorded yet.

drills.lead: [EN] Drills and their texts to the drill roster, never added to the real measures above.
drills.empty: [EN] No drill has been run yet.

about.title: [EN] About this export
about.lead: [EN] The day, the edition and what was left out.

subscribers.title: [EN] SMS subscribers

installs.title: [EN] Web app installs

timing.title: [EN] Acknowledgement, approval and delivery times
timing.lead: [EN] Per alert entry: from the first report to the first approved acknowledgement, from the first save to approval, and from approval to the first text handed off and to 90% of its texts delivered. Then the medians over the alerts, and the time to 90% delivered by language. A text resent after it failed counts once, with the text it replaced, delivered when the first of them was.

checkins.title: [EN] Check-ins
checkins.lead: [EN] The pilot to date: check-ins asked for in the closed rounds and how each request ended, and the number of rounds. Then each closed round: check-ins asked for, by building and floor. How the requests ended is not given by round, building or floor, because with the requests there it could give a hidden count away.

directory_use.title: [EN] Directory and map use
directory_use.lead: [EN] Views of the directory, its listings, the map, the guides and the numbers page, by the page's language and neighbourhood.

search.title: [EN] Search
search.lead: [EN] Questions asked, those with no clear match and those that failed, by the page's language; the share with no clear match, and the median time to answer.

translation.title: [EN] Translation
translation.lead: [EN] How often an approved alert fell back to English, by language; and the survey of residents and ambassadors who understood a translated alert (docs/procedures/survey-results.csv).

corrections.title: [EN] Corrections and their reach
corrections.lead: [EN] Corrections, withdrawals and finals texted, each against the people who got the original. Attempted: handed to the provider. Confirmed: reported delivered.

drills.title: [EN] Drills run
drills.lead: [EN] Each drill and its texts to the drill roster.

cost_per_alert.title: [EN] Cost per alert
cost_per_alert.lead: [EN] Text message cost by language, actual where the provider reported it and an estimate otherwise, labelled; each alert's share of the translation vendor's use in the month; and the month's use by all alerts.

spend.title: [EN] Total spend
spend.lead: [EN] Spend for the pilot to date and this month against the budget of CAD 1,000: actual amounts where a month is reconciled, labelled estimates otherwise. Translation use whose price is unknown is shown as unknown.

coverage.title: [EN] Coverage
coverage.lead: [EN] Pilot buildings and floors with an ambassador assigned, by neighbourhood.

bootstrap.secondAdminOnly: [EN] Setup is not finished. You can add one more Admin now. Other people can be added once both Admins have their own password and authenticator.

people.title: [EN] Add a person
people.lead: [EN] Each person gets their own account. Nothing is sent to them: give them their username and starting password yourself.
people.usernameHint: [EN] People sign in with it. 3 to 32 characters: letters a to z and digits, with a single . _ or - between them.
people.nameHint: [EN] As written in Latin letters. The starting password is made from the first and last name.
people.emailHint: [EN] Kept as a contact detail. The Hub does not send email.
people.createdLine: [EN] Give them these in person. The starting password works once, within 72 hours. They choose their own password when they first sign in.

errors.accountRemoved: [EN] This account was removed and cannot be changed.

signIn.title: [EN] Staff sign-in

signIn.newLead: [EN] An Admin creates your account. There is no public staff registration.
signIn.stepAccount: [EN] Get your username and starting password from your Admin in person.
signIn.stepPassword: [EN] Sign in within 72 hours, then choose your own password. Your starting password works only once.
signIn.stepAuthenticator: [EN] Admins and Coordinators will also be guided through setting up an authenticator app.

signIn.unavailable: [EN] Sign-in is not working right now. Try again in a few minutes.

errors.containsUsername: [EN] Your password cannot contain your username.
errors.isStartingPassword: [EN] Choose a password that is not your starting password.
errors.mismatch: [EN] The two passwords are not the same. Type the same password twice.

errors.unavailable: [EN] Your password could not be saved. Nothing changed. Try again.

errors.passwordsNotConfigured: [EN] Staff passwords are not configured on this site (STAFF_PASSWORD_PEPPER), so nothing was reset. Ask IT to set it.

authenticator.required: [EN] This needs a sign-in confirmed with an authenticator code. Only Admins and Coordinators can do it, after entering their code.
